rationale: Price has been in a clear downtrend throughout the last 5 candles, falling from ~$173.65 to $172.28, sitting at only 22% of today's range and below both VWAP ($173.97) and the 9-EMA ($172.68), suggesting continued selling pressure. However, the spread is 25 bps on a relatively illiquid name (19.92M shares outstanding), the stock already gapped up 13.5% and is now fading, making both long and short entries structurally risky — a long faces overhead supply from the gap and VWAP resistance, while a short risks a snap-back in a broadly strong tape (SPY +4.66%, VIXY -13.39%). With only $981 of daily loss budget remaining and no clear momentum edge in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
